one_line_thesis: Tejon Ranch is a scarce California land bank: $49.

deep_dive.executive_summary: Tejon Ranch is a scarce California land bank: $49.6M FY2025 revenue, entitlements for master-planned communities (Centennial, Grapevine), an active Tejon Ranch Commerce Center (TRCC) industrial platform, water banking, and farming/mineral cash streams. FY2025 net income was essentially break-even after development spend; cash from operations troughed at $6.1M. At ~$18.84 (NYSE, June 3, 2026), our base case is a 7-year dated payoff to $28 per share (conservative acre NAV plus run-rate cash, not GAAP book alone), implying 5.8% per year.
